messages:
sam-customer: Hey team — since the deploy at 2026-03-15T14:20:00Z we're seeing repeated 503s on POST /v1/generate and overall latency jumps. Avg 2.5s, spikes to 8-10s. Example request id: rwd-req-0a1b2c3d. Attaching a minimal curl I used but happy to provide a debug bundle.
lisa-cs: Sorry about the disruption, Sam. We'll triage. Can you include the full response headers (especially x-redwood-request-id / x-trace-id) and a repro curl? If the payload has PII, please scrub before posting here — we can take the scrubbed debug bundle.
debug-bot: Incident logged (INC-2026-1423). Upload debug bundles at https://console.redwood.dev/debug-bundles/upload and include INC-2026-1423 in the description.
maria-support: Assigning to eng. @alex-eng can you pick this up? Sam, please run this local repro and paste headers:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"<short prompt>","max_tokens":64}'
```
We need the full response (status, body) and the response headers: x-redwood-request-id, x-trace-id, x-server-latency.
alex-eng: On it. For a complete repro please collect a debug bundle with the CLI so we can correlate scheduler/node metrics. Example:
```
redwood-debug-bundle collect \
  --req-id rwd-req-0a1b2c3d \
  --include-logs \
  --include-traces \
  --out sam_bundle.tar.gz
```
If you must remove PII before upload, use the scrub command (recommended):
```
redwood-debug-bundle scrub sam_bundle.tar.gz \
  --rules pii --redact-keys Authorization,api_key --map-file pseudomap.csv \
  --out sam_bundle_scrubbed.tar.gz
```
Note: --map-file lets you provide consistent pseudonyms (useful for tracking a user across requests).
chris-privacy: Guidance on pseudonymization/scrubbing: replace email addresses, full names, phone numbers, SSNs, payment tokens. Prefer stable tokens like user_123 rather than removing fields entirely. Example pseudomap.csv rows:
```
"alice@example.com","user_001"
"Alice Johnson","user_AJ"
"+1-415-555-0123","phone_001"
```
Also ensure any Authorization header is replaced with `REDACTED_TOKEN` (we can't accept actual keys). If you need help producing the scrubbed bundle, paste the small prompt/body here and we'll show redaction examples.
sam-customer: Uploading scrubs now. I replaced customer emails with user_001 and phone with phone_001. Attached sam_bundle_scrubbed.tar.gz to INC-2026-1423. Also saw a billing alert at ~14:22:10Z — could there be a ratelimiting or quota/billing throttle contributing?
maria-support: Thanks. Alex — can you correlate rwd-req-0a1b2c3d with cluster allocation + any billing rate-limit events around 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z? If it's a billing enforcement, we'll escalate to finance for a temporary lift.
alex-eng: Will correlate now. Quick note for future captures: include X-Client-Timing header (client-collected timing) and X-Trace-Id so we can stitch client and server traces. If the bundle doesn't include these, ask the customer to re-run the repro with those headers in place.
lisa-cs: Sam — once Alex confirms root cause we'll propose either a temporary capacity bump or a rollback to the previous release. ETA for initial triage: ~90 minutes. :thumbsup:
sam-customer: Appreciate it. One more: in the scrubbed bundle I left placeholders like user_001 in the prompt text; will that be sufficient for you to reproduce behaviors tied to prompt content?
